questions.question: Should you wear gloves while riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Yes. Your hands may get cold while riding.
Yes. They give you a better grip and protect your hands.
No. Gloves can get in the way of the controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes. They give you a better grip and protect your hands.
questions.explanation: Wearing gloves while riding gives you a better grip and protects your hands. Use full-fingered gloves made of durable material.

questions.question: Which colors should motorcycle riders wear?
questions.explanation: Bright orange, red, yellow, and green are the best colors for motorcycle riders. These colors help other drivers see you on the road.

questions.question: If your motorcycle weaves while riding over rain grooves or bridge gratings, you should:

options.text: Speed up to cross the surface faster.
Zigzag to get other drivers' attention.
Keep a steady speed and ride straight across.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a steady speed and ride straight across.
questions.explanation: When your motorcycle weaves on grooves or gratings, keep a steady speed and go straight. Trying to compensate by zigzagging is more dangerous.

questions.question: If vehicles are on both sides of your motorcycle, which lane position is best?
questions.explanation: No lane position is always best. A good rider changes position based on road and traffic conditions. If vehicles are on both sides, the center position is usually safest.

questions.question: To be seen more easily by other drivers, you should:
questions.explanation: Wearing bright-colored clothing makes it easier for other drivers to see you. This is true at any time of day.

questions.question: A rider's boots or shoes should:

options.text: Be made of soft, flexible material.

questions.explanation: Choose sturdy footwear that is high enough to cover and support your ankles. Soles should be made of hard, durable, slip-resistant material.

questions.question: You see an emergency vehicle stopped on the roadside with flashing lights. You should:

options.text: Stop on the roadway behind the emergency vehicle.
Stop and wait until the emergency vehicle moves.
Move to a different lane away from the emergency vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to a different lane away from the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle, tow truck, or roadside assistance vehicle with flashing lights, change lanes to give it extra space. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, your lane position:

options.text: Does not affect whether other drivers can see you.
Is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
Cannot protect you from wind blasts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
questions.explanation: A good lane position helps you see others and helps them see you. Good positioning also protects you from wind blasts from other vehicles.

questions.question: Wind noise while riding:

options.text: Is easy to get used to.

questions.explanation: Long-term exposure to wind noise can permanently damage your hearing. Wear ear plugs or other hearing protection when riding.

questions.question: Which footwear is best for a motorcycle operator?
questions.explanation: Sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles provide the best protection. Laced-up boots are best, but high-top boots and heavy shoes work too. If your shoes have long laces, tuck them in securely before riding.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Blue signs with white letters show where services are located. These include rest areas, gas stations, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: How do reflective, brightly-colored helmets and clothing help riders?

options.text: Should only be worn when riding at night.
They help other drivers see you better.
They do not make riding safer.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help other drivers see you better.
questions.explanation: Wearing bright or reflective clothing makes it easier for other drivers to see you on the road.

questions.question: What is most important for helmet protection?
questions.explanation: Your helmet protects you best when it meets safety standards, fits snugly all around, and has no damage.

questions.question: How can you avoid getting tired on a long ride?

options.text: Take frequent breaks and limit riding time each day.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take frequent breaks and limit riding time each day.
questions.explanation: Take breaks often to rest, even if you do not feel tired. Experienced riders do not ride more than six hours a day. Wind, cold, and rain make you tire faster, so dress to protect yourself.

questions.question: When should you use the front brake?
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes when you slow down or stop.

questions.question: When should you use your headlight?
questions.explanation: Use your headlight for safety. Other drivers see your headlight before they see your motorcycle. South Carolina law requires your headlight to be on whenever you ride.

questions.question: Do motorcycle mirrors have blind spots?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle mirrors have blind spots just like car mirrors. Always turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show traffic laws for that area. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What should you check before every ride?
questions.explanation: Always do a safety check before riding. Test your brakes to make sure the brake lights come on.

questions.question: What does a solid white line on the side of the road show?

options.text: The right edge of a traffic lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right edge of a traffic lane.
questions.explanation: A solid white line on the side of the road marks the right edge of a traffic lane.

questions.question: When riding on a slippery surface, you should:
questions.explanation: On a slippery surface, sudden changes in speed or direction can cause a skid. Speed up, shift gears, turn, and brake smoothly.

questions.question: When should you inspect your motorcycle for safety?
questions.explanation: Always check your motorcycle before you ride. Even small problems on a motorcycle are more dangerous than small problems on a car.

questions.question: What should you wear when riding during the day?

options.text: Bright-colored clothing so others can see you.
Any color clothing because drivers can see you in daylight.
Dark-colored clothing to stand out against the sun.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright-colored clothing so others can see you.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Always wear bright colors to be more visible, even during the day.

questions.question: How do you control the accelerator?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is on the right handgrip and you control it with your right hand.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On a slippery surface, reduce your speed, avoid sudden movements, and use both brakes.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol and drugs are used together?

options.text: They are less dangerous than when used alone.
Their effects balance each other out.
Their effects can be stronger than when used alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Their effects can be stronger than when used alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, can affect your riding. Some drugs become more dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: What should you do when railroad crossing lights are flashing?

options.text: Stop and wait until the train passes.
Turn around and find another route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait until the train passes.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with flashing lights, come to a complete stop. Wait until the train passes and the lights stop flashing before moving. Never try to cross in front of a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What is required regarding motorcycle footrests?

options.text: The driver and passenger can share footrests
Footrests are required for both the driver and passenger

questions.correctAnswerText: Footrests are required for both the driver and passenger
questions.explanation: Keep your feet on the footrests for balance. Your motorcycle must have passenger footrests. Proper footing keeps your passenger from falling and taking you with them.

questions.question: How should a protective jacket fit?

options.text: Loose so it flaps in the wind while riding

questions.explanation: Riding clothes should protect you and keep you comfortable. Jackets and pants should fit snugly so they don't flap in the wind, but loose enough to move freely.
